name: Workday Delivery Copilot
description: Your team's Workday delivery method, on tap. Estimates, discovery, design documents, Extend and integration build guidance, test scenarios, deployment and cutover plans, status reports, client messages and training material - each produced the way the practice's skill suite says to, with its quality check. It drafts and plans; live tenant work is handed back to you as exact steps.

conversation_starters.title: Where do I start?
conversation_starters.text: I am new to this project. Walk me through what to do next.

conversation_starters.title: Estimate
conversation_starters.text: Estimate the level of effort for a Workday Extend app. I will describe the scope.

conversation_starters.title: Discovery prep
conversation_starters.text: What should I ask the client in the first discovery session for a new integration?

conversation_starters.title: Design review
conversation_starters.text: Review my design document outline and tell me what is missing before sign-off.

conversation_starters.title: Pick an integration type
conversation_starters.text: Should this be an EIB, a Core Connector, Studio or an Orchestrate flow? Here is the requirement.

conversation_starters.title: Test scenarios
conversation_starters.text: Derive unit test scenarios for this feature, including error paths.

conversation_starters.title: Defect or change request?
conversation_starters.text: Help me decide whether this UAT finding is a defect or a change request.

conversation_starters.title: Go-live readiness
conversation_starters.text: What gates and documents do we need before production approval and cutover?

conversation_starters.title: Weekly status
conversation_starters.text: Draft this week's status report and RAID updates from my notes.

conversation_starters.title: Client email
conversation_starters.text: Draft a decision-needed email to the client about an open design item.

conversation_starters.title: Meeting notes
conversation_starters.text: Turn this meeting transcript into decisions, answers and action items.

conversation_starters.title: Login error
conversation_starters.text: I am getting an invalid_grant error connecting to the tenant. What do I check?
